notes: Real-catalogue pilot (M4, 2026-11-21), prepared by the coding agent. Every fact below was read from the cited source on 2026-11-21: GBIF Backbone Taxonomy (CC BY 4.0) through the GBIF API, Wikidata (CC0) through its API, and GBIF species profiles. IUCN Red List pages were NOT read: iucnredlist.org disallows this agent in robots.txt and returned 403, so status is cited second-hand from Wikidata, which references The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species 2022.2 (DECISIONS D-027). No population figure was checked, so every population is Unknown. Trend is not stated by Wikidata, so it is 'unknown'. Images are from Wikimedia Commons; each licence was read from the file's Commons metadata. Image licences were also compared with each file's embedded copyright metadata; a file whose metadata said 'all rights reserved' was not used. The three image files are stored next to this file in media/, downloaded unchanged from the Commons URLs on 2026-11-21 (source pages in sourceUrl). Population figures were added on 2026-11-21 at the owner's request from pages read that day: IUCN/SSC Cat Specialist Group (snow leopard), Wikipedia citing CITES (axolotl), and the U.S. National Park Service (hawksbill nesting females by country; no global total was found). The WWF hawksbill page refused access (403) and was not used.

editorial.overview: The snow leopard is a wild cat of the family Felidae, in the order Carnivora. Name use differs between sources: Wikidata uses Panthera uncia, while the GBIF Backbone Taxonomy accepts Uncia uncia and lists Panthera uncia as a synonym. It is listed as Vulnerable in the 2022.2 edition of the IUCN Red List, as recorded on Wikidata.

editorial.overview: The axolotl is a salamander of the family Ambystomatidae, in the order Caudata. The World Register of Marine Species, as listed by GBIF, records it as a freshwater species and not a marine one. It is listed as Critically Endangered in the 2022.2 edition of the IUCN Red List, as recorded on Wikidata.

editorial.overview: The hawksbill sea turtle is a turtle of the family Cheloniidae. The World Register of Marine Species, as listed by GBIF, records it as a marine species. It is listed as Critically Endangered in the 2022.2 edition of the IUCN Red List, as recorded on Wikidata.
